critique.summary: Test fixture: a clean checkout layout with weak contrast on secondary text and the main button.

issues.title: Button label is hard to read
issues.problem: White text on light orange is below 4.5:1.
issues.fix: Darken the button to #b35c00 or use dark text.

issues.title: Item descriptions are faint
issues.problem: Light grey text on white is hard to read.

issues.title: Edit link looks disabled
issues.problem: The grey Edit link reads as inactive.
issues.fix: Use the accent colour and a larger tap target.
